messages:
jia: Heads-up — new intake submitted from partner org for an open-weight model (working name: alpaca-7b-open-intake). Need owners for perf profiles, catalog metadata, and a quick licensing check. Intake doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INTAKE-3482 :link: 

oliver: I'll take perf ownership. Will run baseline + q configs. ETA: EOD Thu. Can someone drop a small prompt/test-set into the intake ticket?

mika: I'll own catalog metadata + rollout UX. Quick Q: are we treating this as "public" or do we need gating for license? cc @andrew for legal.

sam: Ping — I'll run perf bench once I have model artifacts + test set. Plan: int8 & q4f16 runs, 512-context eval, and a tiny latency run. Add a short eval harness in the intake ticket pls. :wave:

jia: Added test-set & minimal eval plan to INTAKE-3482. Also flagged license in the manifest: 
```
license: CC-BY-NC-4.0
source: s3://partner-upload/alpaca-7b.tar
spdx: CC-BY-NC-4.0
```
Partner attached upstream LICENSE file.

andrew: NC clause blocks commercial usage. We can use it for internal evals but we cannot list it in the public catalog or mark it as freely redistributable. Options: (1) ask partner for relicense (MIT/BSD), (2) onboard as "restricted" with gating, or (3) decline. Which do you want?

lisa: Product preference: ask for relicense first (MIT ideally). If partner refuses, we onboard as restricted behind an enterprise flag for Dedicated/Private only. Need SLA classification too.

mika: I'll add a "restricted" tag + gating UX. For rollout: canary to 5% on staging, monitor perf and quality, then 25% then prod. Owners map: oliver (perf), mika (catalog), andrew (legal), sam (bench). I'll make these owners official in the catalog ticket. :thumbsup:

jia: Sounds good. Timeline proposal: perf bench by Thu EOD, legal decision by Fri EOD, catalog UI and gating added by next Wed. I'll update INTAKE-3482 and ping infra for artifact access.

oliver: Infra dep: need access to 'dedicated-qa' GPU pool and s3 read to s3://partner-upload/alpaca-7b.tar. Also need model-arch metadata (vocab size, kv-cache true/false). @infra-bot can you create the access request?

infra-bot: Access request INF-902 created. Awaiting infra-oncall approval. See https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-902

mika: Adding an automatic rollback config — if perf degradation >5% vs baseline or latency p95 increases by >30%, system autos-rollback. Draft config saved to repo: 
```
{
  "rollout": "canary",
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "metrics": {
    "perf_regression_pct": 5,
    "latency_p95_increase_pct": 30
  },
  "rollback": "auto"
}
```
Will link PR in the ticket.

sam: Quick question — which baseline should I compare against? redwood/llama-2-7b or redwood/alpaca-7b-v1? For prompt parity I'd normally use the existing alpaca-7b-v1 baseline.

jia: Use redwood/alpaca-7b-v1 as the QA baseline for parity with our prompt set. If bench shows big wins vs llama-2-7b we can call that out in the release notes.

andrew: If partner is willing to dual-license, legal can expedite. I'll draft an email template you can send to partner legal — dropping to INTAKE-3482.

lisa: One more ask from Product: add SLA tier suggestion on the intake form (experimental / standard / enterprise) — helps decide whether to include in Hosted catalog or Dedicated only.

mika: Added SLA dropdown to intake schema in PR #562. Also added 'restricted' UI copy and a tooltip explaining NC limitations.

jia: Thanks all — owners set on INTAKE-3482. I'll follow up with partner for relicensing ask and update timeline if infra grant is delayed. For now owners & deps captured. :raised_hands:
